petrochina-company-limited.name: PetroChina Company Limited
petrochina-company-limited.description: PetroChina Company Limited is a Chinese oil and gas company headquartered in Dongcheng District, Beijing. It is the listed arm of state-owned China National Petroleum Corporation and is Asia's largest oil and gas producer. It is traded in Hong Kong and New York.

porsche-automobil-holding-se.name: Porsche Automobil Holding SE
porsche-automobil-holding-se.description: Porsche Automobil Holding SE is a German multinational corporation headquartered in Zuffenhausen, Stuttgart. It is primarily known as a holding company of Volkswagen Group with investments in the automotive industry. The company was founded in 1931 by Ferdinand Porsche and Anton Piëch.

panasonic-holdings-corporation.name: Panasonic Holdings Corporation
panasonic-holdings-corporation.description: Panasonic Holdings Corporation is a Japanese multinational electronics manufacturer headquartered in Kadoma, Osaka. It produces consumer electronics, batteries, automotive and avionic systems, and industrial equipment. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and other indices.

prosegur.name: Prosegur
prosegur.description: Prosegur Compañía de Seguridad, S.A. is a multinational security company headquartered in Madrid, Spain. It operates in the cash-in-transit industry providing security services internationally.

procter-gamble.name: Procter & Gamble
procter-gamble.description: The Procter & Gamble Company (P&G) is an American multinational consumer goods corporation headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio. It was founded in 1837 by William Procter and James Gamble.

publicis.name: Publicis
publicis.description: Publicis Groupe S.A. is a French multinational advertising and public relations company based in Paris. It is the largest advertising company in the world by revenue as of 2024. The company provides digital and traditional advertising, media, and marketing services.

philip-morris-international.name: Philip Morris International
philip-morris-international.description: Philip Morris International Inc. is an American publicly traded tobacco company with products sold in over 180 countries. Marlboro is its most recognized brand, and Iqos generated the greatest revenue in late 2023. It is considered part of Big Tobacco.

pilgrim-s-corp.name: Pilgrim's Corp
pilgrim-s-corp.description: Pilgrim's Pride Corporation is an American multinational food company and one of the largest chicken producers in the US and Puerto Rico, as well as the second-largest in Mexico. It emerged from bankruptcy in 2009, relocated its US headquarters to Colorado in 2011, and is majority-owned by Brazilian JBS S.A.

parker-hannifin.name: Parker Hannifin
parker-hannifin.description: Parker-Hannifin Corporation is an American multinational industrial manufacturing company specializing in motion and control technologies. Founded in 1917, it is headquartered in Mayfield Heights, Ohio. The company employs about 61,000 people globally and is one of the largest in its sector.

pnc-financial-services.name: PNC Financial Services
pnc-financial-services.description: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. is an American bank holding company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Its subsidiary, PNC Bank, operates in 27 states and the District of Columbia with thousands of branches and ATMs. It is one of the largest banks in the US by assets and branch network.

pjsc-inter-rao.name: PJSC Inter RAO
pjsc-inter-rao.description: Joint Stock Company Inter RAO UES is a diversified energy holding company headquartered in Moscow, Russia. It operates in power and heat generation, electricity supply, international energy trading, and electric power infrastructure development. The company holds a monopoly on electricity export and import in Russia.

pge-polska-grupa-energetyczna.name: PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna
pge-polska-grupa-energetyczna.description: PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna S.A. is a state-owned public power company and the largest power producer in Poland. It is listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange and is part of the WIG30 index.

posco.name: POSCO
posco.description: POSCO is a South Korean steel manufacturer headquartered in Pohang, South Korea. It was the world's largest steel manufacturing company by market value in 2010 and ranked as the seventh-largest steelmaker by output in 2015.

petronas.name: Petronas
petronas.description: Petroliam Nasional Berhad, known as Petronas, is a Malaysian multinational oil and gas company headquartered in Kuala Lumpur. Established in 1974, it holds all oil and gas resources in Malaysia and is responsible for developing and adding value to these resources.

prysmian-group.name: Prysmian Group
prysmian-group.description: Prysmian S.p.A. is an Italian multinational company headquartered in Milan, specializing in electrical and optical cables for digital connections. It operates 109 plants worldwide, including locations in North America, LATAM, and EMEA. The company focuses on production, installation, and maintenance of cables.

pirelli.name: Pirelli
pirelli.description: Pirelli & C. S.p.A. is an Italian multinational tyre manufacturer headquartered in Milan. It is the fifth-largest tyre manufacturer globally, producing tyres for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. The company operates in over 160 countries with 18 manufacturing sites across 12 countries.

paccar.name: PACCAR
paccar.description: Paccar Inc. is an American company headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, that manufactures heavy-duty trucks. It operates subsidiaries including Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF Trucks. The company also provides financial services and industrial parts.

prudential-plc.name: Prudential plc
prudential-plc.description: Prudential plc is a British multinational insurance and asset management company headquartered in London and Hong Kong. Founded in 1848, it originally provided loans to professional and working people.

papa-john-s.name: Papa John's
papa-john-s.description: Papa John's International, Inc. is an American pizza restaurant chain founded in Jeffersonville, Indiana, in 1984. It went public in 1993 and expanded rapidly. As of 2023, it is the fourth largest pizza delivery chain in the United States with headquarters in Louisville, Kentucky, and Atlanta, Georgia.

power-machines.name: Power Machines
power-machines.description: OJSC Power Machines is a Russian energy systems machine-building company founded in 2000. It is headquartered in Saint Petersburg.

pacific-gas-and-electric-company.name: Pacific Gas and Electric Company
pacific-gas-and-electric-company.description: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E) is an American investor-owned utility headquartered in Oakland, California. It supplies natural gas and electricity to 5.2 million households across northern California.

pernod-ricard.name: Pernod Ricard
pernod-ricard.description: Pernod Ricard is a French company known for its anise-flavoured pastis apéritifs Pernod Anise and Ricard Pastis. It is the world's second-largest wine and spirits seller and produces several other types of pastis.

paramount-global.name: Paramount Global
paramount-global.description: Paramount Global, commonly known as Paramount, was an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate headquartered in Midtown Manhattan. It was formed in 2019 as ViacomCBS through a merger and renamed Paramount in 2022.

phosagro.name: PhosAgro
phosagro.description: PhosAgro is a Russian chemical holding company based in Moscow. It produces fertilizer, phosphates, and feed phosphates, and owns subsidiaries including Apatit, which extracts apatite rock. PhosAgro is Europe's largest producer of phosphate-based fertilizers.

public-power-corporation-sa.name: Public Power Corporation SA
public-power-corporation-sa.description: Public Power Corporation S.A. is the largest electric power company in Greece. In 2023, it acquired Enel Romania from the Italian Enel group. The company operates in the electricity generation sector.

proximus-group.name: Proximus Group
proximus-group.description: The Proximus Group provides digital services and communication solutions in Belgium and internationally. It operates under brands like Proximus, Scarlet, and Mobile Vikings in Belgium and has operations in Luxembourg and the Netherlands. The group also includes an ecosystem of IT partners.

palo-alto-networks.name: Palo Alto Networks
palo-alto-networks.description: Palo Alto Networks, Inc. is an American multinational cybersecurity company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It offers a platform with advanced firewalls and cloud-based security services, serving over 70,000 organizations worldwide.

paul-hartmann-ag.name: Paul Hartmann AG
paul-hartmann-ag.description: The Hartmann Group is a German manufacturer of medical and care products headquartered in Heidenheim, Baden-Württemberg. It operates in wound care, incontinence management, and infection management segments, providing products and associated services.

parametric-technology-corporation.name: Parametric Technology Corporation
parametric-technology-corporation.description: PTC Inc. is an American computer software and services company founded in 1985 and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It pioneered parametric CAD modeling software and offers products including an Internet of Things and augmented reality platform.

prosiebensat-1-media-se.name: ProSiebenSat.1 Media SE
prosiebensat-1-media-se.description: ProSiebenSat.1 Media SE is a German mass media and digital company based in Unterföhring near Munich. It operates in three segments: Entertainment, Dating, and Commerce & Ventures. The company is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and majority-owned by MediaForEurope.

playtech.name: Playtech
playtech.description: Playtech plc is a gambling software development company founded in 1999 and based in the Isle of Man. It provides software for online casinos, poker rooms, bingo games, sports betting, mobile gaming, and live dealer games. Playtech is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

podravka.name: Podravka
podravka.description: Podravka d.d. is a Croatian food company based in Koprivnica. Founded in 1934, it is one of the largest food companies in Southeast Europe. The company operates in the food industry.

people-incorporated.name: People Incorporated
people-incorporated.description: People Incorporated is an American conglomerate owning People Inc. and The Daily Beast. It holds significant shares in MGM Resorts International and Turo. The company operates in the media industry.

potbelly-sandwich-shop.name: Potbelly Sandwich Shop
potbelly-sandwich-shop.description: Potbelly Sandwich Shop is an American fast-casual restaurant chain specializing in submarine sandwiches and milkshakes. It has over 400 locations and is owned by RaceTrac.

piaggio.name: Piaggio
piaggio.description: Piaggio Group is an Italian motor vehicle manufacturer headquartered in Pontedera, Italy. Founded in 1884, it produces two-wheeled motor vehicles and compact commercial vehicles under brands including Piaggio, Vespa, and Aprilia.

partner-communications-company-ltd.name: Partner Communications Company Ltd.
partner-communications-company-ltd.description: Partner Communications Company Ltd., formerly Orange Israel, is an Israeli telecommunications provider offering mobile network, internet Wi-Fi, fixed telephony, OTT/IPTV, international calling, and business solutions. It operates a mobile network with a standalone 5G core and a nationwide fiber-optic broadband network.

palantir-technologies.name: Palantir Technologies
palantir-technologies.description: Palantir Technologies Inc. is an American company that develops data integration and analytics software. It is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and was founded in Palo Alto, California in 2003 by Peter Thiel and others. The company operates in the technology sector.

polycom.name: Polycom
polycom.description: Polycom, Inc. was an American multinational corporation that developed video, voice, and content collaboration and communication technology. It was co-founded in 1990 by Brian L Hinman and Jeffrey Rodman. The company specialized in video conference technology.

polaris-media.name: Polaris Media
polaris-media.description: Polaris Media ASA is a Norwegian media group owning thirty newspapers, including Adresseavisen and Sunnmørsposten. Based in Trondheim and established in 2008, the company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.

pony-ai.name: Pony.ai
pony-ai.description: Pony AI Inc. is a Chinese autonomous vehicle technology company with locations in Silicon Valley, Beijing, and Guangzhou. It focuses on developing autonomous car technologies.

patrizia-immobilien.name: Patrizia Immobilien
patrizia-immobilien.description: Patrizia is a German investment management company focused on the European real estate market. Based in Augsburg, it is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and is a member of the SDAX and MSCI World Small Cap Index.

piquadro.name: Piquadro
piquadro.description: Piquadro S.p.A. is an Italian leather goods company headquartered in Silla di Gaggio Montano, Bologna. Founded in 1987 by Marco Palmieri, it designs, manufactures, and distributes premium leather accessories under three brands: Piquadro, The Bridge, and Lancel.

planet-labs.name: Planet Labs
planet-labs.description: Planet Labs PBC, known as Planet., is an American Earth imaging company based in San Francisco, California. It aims to image the entire Earth daily to monitor changes and identify trends. The company is publicly traded.

paradox-interactive.name: Paradox Interactive
paradox-interactive.description: Paradox Interactive AB is a video game publisher headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. It originated as part of Target Games and Paradox Entertainment before becoming independent in 2004. The company includes nine first-party development studios and publishes games from other developers.

protector-forsikring.name: Protector Forsikring
protector-forsikring.description: Protector Forsikring ASA is a Norwegian multinational insurance company headquartered in Oslo. It offers property and casualty insurance services. The company operates within the financial services industry.

phunware.name: Phunware
phunware.description: Phunware Inc. is a publicly traded enterprise software company headquartered in Austin, Texas. Founded in 2009, it builds cloud-based platforms for user engagement in marketing and public relations. Its services include mobile app development, location-based services, digital advertising, and generative AI tools.

pool-corporation.name: Pool Corporation
pool-corporation.description: Pool Corporation, known as POOLCORP, is the largest global distributor of swimming pool supplies, equipment, and machinery. Headquartered in Covington, Louisiana, it operates 439 sales centers across North America, Europe, and Australia.

pepper-lunch.name: Pepper Lunch
pepper-lunch.description: Pepper Lunch is a Japanese fast-steak restaurant franchise popular in the Tokyo area. As of 2026, it operates approximately 575 locations.

pagaya-technologies.name: Pagaya technologies
pagaya-technologies.description: Pagaya Technologies is an Israeli-American financial technology company based in New York City. It uses artificial intelligence to evaluate loan applications and has been listed on the New York Stock Exchange since 2022.

persimmon-plc.name: Persimmon plc
persimmon-plc.description: Persimmon plc is a British housebuilding company headquartered in York, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

persol-holdings-co-ltd.name: Persol Holdings Co., Ltd.
persol-holdings-co-ltd.description: Persol Holdings is a Japanese human resource management company providing labor hire services to clients. The company operates in Japan and focuses on employment services.

pvh-corp.name: PVH Corp.
pvh-corp.description: PVH Corp., formerly Phillips-Van Heusen Corporation, is an American clothing company that owns brands such as Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein. It also licenses brands including Kenneth Cole New York and Michael Kors.

papyless.name: Papyless
papyless.description: Papyless Co. Ltd., formerly Fuji Online Systems, is a Japanese e-book distribution company established in 1995. It is the parent company of Renta!, a digital manga online rental service.

precision-biosciences.name: Precision BioSciences
precision-biosciences.description: Precision BioSciences, Inc. is a publicly traded American clinical stage gene editing company headquartered in Durham, North Carolina. Founded in 2006, it develops gene editing therapies using its proprietary ARCUS genome editing platform.

perion-network-ltd.name: Perion Network Ltd.
perion-network-ltd.description: Perion Network Ltd. is an Israeli technology company providing digital advertising products and services. It is headquartered in Tel Aviv and has offices in multiple cities including New York, Los Angeles, and London.

pt-suparma-tbk.name: PT Suparma Tbk
pt-suparma-tbk.description: Suparma is an Indonesian pulp and paper company based in Surabaya, East Java. Founded in 1976 by Welly, the company operates in the agriculture sector focusing on pulp and paper production.

perusahaan-gas-negara.name: Perusahaan Gas Negara
perusahaan-gas-negara.description: PT Pertamina Gas Negara Tbk is an Indonesian natural gas transportation and distribution company. It operates 3,187 km of distribution pipelines serving around 84 million customers. The company adopted its current name and Pertamina branding in 2021.

pilot-corporation.name: Pilot Corporation
pilot-corporation.description: Pilot Corporation is a Japanese pen manufacturer based in Tokyo. It produces writing instruments, stationery, and jewellery, and is best known for its pens.

padini.name: Padini
padini.description: Padini Holdings Berhad is a Malaysian fashion company that primarily exports its manufactured goods to the Middle East and Southeast Asia. It operates in the clothing industry.

prosafe-se.name: Prosafe SE
prosafe-se.description: Prosafe SE is a company specializing in owning and operating semi-submersible accommodation vessels. It is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange. The company is based in Norway.

pccw-limited.name: PCCW Limited
pccw-limited.description: PCCW Limited is an information and communication technology and telecommunications company based in Hong Kong. It provides ICT and telecom services in the region.

plus500.name: Plus500
plus500.description: Plus500 is a global multi-asset financial technology company headquartered in Haifa, Israel. It provides online trading services including contracts for difference, share dealing, futures trading, prediction markets, and options on futures. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

positivo-tecnologia.name: Positivo Tecnologia
positivo-tecnologia.description: Positivo Tecnologia is a Brazilian company headquartered in Curitiba, Paraná. It provides end-to-end IT infrastructure solutions and develops, manufactures, and sells computers, mobile phones, tablets, smart home and office devices, servers, payment solutions, educational technologies, and electronic security solutions.

publicis-sapient.name: Publicis Sapient
publicis-sapient.description: Publicis Sapient is a technology company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It operates as an independent subsidiary of Publicis Groupe and was originally established as Sapient in Cambridge, Massachusetts in 1990. In 2015, it became an independent subsidiary of the French multinational advertising firm Publicis.

ptt-global-chemical-public-company-limit.name: PTT Global Chemical Public Company Limited
ptt-global-chemical-public-company-limit.legal_name: PTT Global Chemical Public Company Limited
ptt-global-chemical-public-company-limit.description: PTT Global Chemical (PTTGC) is a petrochemical company specializing in synthesizing olefins and aromatics. Founded in 2011, it is a subsidiary of PTT Public Company Limited and operates in Thailand.

listings.name: PTT Global Chemical Public Company Limited

phillips-66.name: Phillips 66
phillips-66.description: Phillips 66 Company is an American multinational energy company based in Houston, Texas. It was formed after the merger of Phillips Petroleum and Conoco, and later spun off its downstream operations into the Phillips 66 entity. The company began trading on the New York Stock Exchange in 2012.

playmates-toys.name: Playmates Toys
playmates-toys.description: Playmates Toys Limited is a Hong Kong-based manufacturing company founded in 1966. It initially manufactured dolls for other companies before marketing its own preschool toy line starting in 1975. The company established subsidiaries in the United States and went public in 1984.

pax-global-technology-limited.name: PAX Global Technology Limited
pax-global-technology-limited.description: PAX Technology is a Chinese manufacturer of payment terminals, PIN pads, and point of sale hardware and software. The company is headquartered in Shenzhen, listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, and sells its products globally.

packaging-corporation-of-america.name: Packaging Corporation of America
packaging-corporation-of-america.description: Packaging Corporation of America is an American manufacturing company headquartered in Lake Forest, Illinois. It primarily operates in the United States and employs about 15,500 people.

park-electrochemical-corp.name: Park Electrochemical Corp
park-electrochemical-corp.description: Park Electrochemical Corp, now Park Aerospace Corp, is a materials manufacturer based in Melville, New York. It produces high-technology printed circuit materials and composite materials for telecommunications, aerospace, and high-end computing industries.

poshmark.name: Poshmark
poshmark.description: Poshmark, Inc. is a social commerce marketplace headquartered in Redwood City, California. It allows users to buy and sell new and second-hand fashion, home goods, and electronics, and has offices in Vancouver, Chennai, and New York City.

patriot-national-bancorp.name: Patriot National Bancorp
patriot-national-bancorp.description: Patriot Bank, N.A. is a bank holding company based in Stamford, Connecticut. It operates Patriot Bank NA and is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol PNBK.

powerwave-technologies.name: Powerwave Technologies
powerwave-technologies.description: Powerwave Technologies Inc. was a global telecommunications corporation founded in 1985 and disbanded in 2013. It produced wireless infrastructure products such as antennas, base stations, and coverage systems supporting major frequency bands and air interfaces, focusing on expanding coverage, capacity, and data speed including 4G WiMAX and LTE systems.

paycom.name: Paycom
paycom.description: Paycom Software, Inc., known as Paycom, is an online payroll and human resource software provider based in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. Founded in 1998, it has offices throughout the United States and is recognized as one of the first fully online payroll providers.

pra-health-sciences.name: PRA Health Sciences
pra-health-sciences.description: PRA Health Sciences was a contract research organization headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. Established in 1976, it was acquired by ICON in 2021.

pixelworks.name: Pixelworks
pixelworks.description: Pixelworks, Inc. is a semiconductor company founded in 1997 and based in San Jose, California. It provides video and pixel processing semiconductors and software, as well as digital display, projection devices, and digital signage products.

pernix-therapeutics-holdings.name: Pernix Therapeutics Holdings
pernix-therapeutics-holdings.description: Pernix Therapeutics was a specialty pharmaceutical company focused on acquiring, developing, and commercializing prescription drugs primarily for the U.S. market. It operated within the pharmaceutical industry in the United States.

pacwest-bancorp.name: PacWest Bancorp
pacwest-bancorp.description: PacWest Bancorp was an American bank holding company based in Beverly Hills, California. It owned Pacific Western Bank as its wholly owned banking subsidiary and was a subsidiary of Banc of California.

proto-labs.name: Proto Labs
proto-labs.description: Protolabs is a manufacturing company headquartered in Maple Plain, Minnesota, USA. It provides rapid manufacturing of custom parts using 3D printing, CNC machining, sheet metal, and injection molding for various markets including medical devices and aerospace. The company operates manufacturing facilities in the U.S., England, and Germany.

plum-creek-timber.name: Plum Creek Timber
plum-creek-timber.description: Plum Creek Timber Company, Inc. was a US timberland owner and manager involved in forest products, mineral extraction, and property development. It was headquartered in Seattle before merging with Weyerhaeuser Company.

pse-composite-index.name: PSE Composite Index
pse-composite-index.description: The PSE Composite Index, or PSEi, is the main stock market index of the Philippines. It consists of 30 of the largest companies traded on the Philippine Stock Exchange, contrasting with the broader PSE All Shares Index.

peabody-energy.name: Peabody Energy
peabody-energy.description: Peabody Energy is an American coal mining company headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. It mines, sells, and distributes coal used in electricity generation and steelmaking, and also markets and trades coal through offices in China, Australia, and the United States.

polaris.name: Polaris
polaris.description: Polaris Inc. is an American automotive manufacturer headquartered in Medina, Minnesota. Founded in Roseau, Minnesota, it has produced motorcycles and personal watercraft and underwent a name change in 2019.

puuilo.name: Puuilo
puuilo.description: Puuilo is a Finnish retail chain founded in 1982 specializing in DIY products including tools, construction, electrical, and plumbing supplies. It also sells garden, car, household, pet, and leisure products. Puuilo operates about 60 stores across Finland and plans to expand into Sweden by 2026.

prada.name: Prada
prada.description: Prada S.p.A. is an Italian luxury fashion house founded in 1913 in Milan by Mario Prada. The company licenses its name and branding to Luxottica for eyewear and L'Oréal for fragrances and cosmetics. Prada is a notable name in the fashion industry.

prio.name: PRIO
prio.description: PRIO S.A. is a Brazilian publicly traded company focused on oil and gas production. It specializes in efficient reservoir management and development of mature fields without investing in asset recovery.

pakuwon-jati.name: Pakuwon Jati
pakuwon-jati.description: PT Pakuwon Jati Tbk is an Indonesian real estate developer based in Surabaya. It is the holding company of Pakuwon Group, founded in 1982, and focuses on constructing shopping centres and office buildings in Surabaya and Jakarta. Pakuwon Jati is known for embodying the superblock concept in Indonesia, integrating malls, offices, condominiums, and hotels.

paysafe-group.name: Paysafe Group
paysafe-group.description: Paysafe Limited is a multinational online payments company offering payment processing, digital wallet, and online cash systems to businesses and consumers. It serves the global entertainment sectors and operates under the Paysafe brand and several subsidiaries acquired through mergers and acquisitions.

pra-group.name: PRA Group
pra-group.description: PRA Group, Inc. is a publicly traded debt buyer and collection company headquartered in Norfolk, Virginia, United States. It purchases delinquent consumer debt from financial institutions at a discount and collects the full amount owed.

polyus.name: Polyus
polyus.description: PJSC Polyus is a Russian gold mining company headquartered in Moscow. It is the largest gold producer in Russia and among the top 10 globally by output. Its main assets are located in Eastern Siberia and the Russian Far East.

pharmacyclics.name: Pharmacyclics
pharmacyclics.description: Pharmacyclics LLC is an American biopharmaceutical company based in Sunnyvale, California. It focuses on developing cancer therapies. In 2017, Xynomic Pharmaceuticals acquired all global rights to its primary commercial product, Abexinostat.

ppl.name: PPL
ppl.description: PPL Corporation is an energy company headquartered in Allentown, Pennsylvania. It operates in the electricity supply sector and serves millions of customers in the eastern Pennsylvania region.

paladin-energy.name: Paladin Energy
paladin-energy.description: Paladin Energy Ltd is a uranium mining company based in Western Australia. It operates in the mining and metals industry.

prfoods.name: PRFoods
prfoods.description: PRFoods is an Estonian company involved in fish farming, production, and sales. It operates within the food industry focusing on seafood products.

perkinelmer.name: PerkinElmer
perkinelmer.description: PerkinElmer, Inc. is an American global corporation founded in 1937, originally focused on precision optics. It now specializes in diagnostics, life science research, food, environmental and industrial testing, producing analytical instruments and diagnostic tools worldwide.

pacific-biosciences.name: Pacific Biosciences
pacific-biosciences.description: Pacific Biosciences of California, Inc. is an American biotechnology company founded in 2004. It develops and manufactures gene sequencing systems, including two principal sequencing platforms: single-molecule real-time sequencing and sequencing by binding chemistry.

performance-food-group.name: Performance Food Group
performance-food-group.description: Performance Food Group Company is an American food service distributor. It is the third-largest food service distributor in the U.S., supplying 250,000 products to 300,000 locations including restaurants, healthcare, hospitality, and educational institutions.

primoris-services-corporation.name: Primoris Services Corporation
primoris-services-corporation.description: Primoris Services Corporation is a publicly traded specialty construction and infrastructure company in the United States. It focuses on pipelines for natural gas, wastewater, and water. In 2026, it was ranked 497th in the Fortune 500.

pros.name: PROS
pros.description: PROS Holdings, Inc. is a technology company headquartered in Houston, Texas, that provides revenue management, dynamic pricing, and digital retailing solutions. After acquisition by Thoma Bravo, it refocused exclusively on the airline industry. PROS operates globally with offices in Europe and North America.

pruksa-holding.name: Pruksa Holding
pruksa-holding.description: Pruksa Real Estate Public Company Limited is one of Thailand's largest real estate developers. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Bangkok, it is listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand.

partypoker.name: partypoker
partypoker.description: PartyPoker is an online poker card room launched in 2001 by PartyGaming. It was once the largest online card room and is now run by Entain, available in 14 languages with dedicated networks for several regions.

progress-energy.name: Progress Energy
progress-energy.description: Progress Energy was a power generation and distribution company headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. It served about 3.1 million customers in the Carolinas and Florida before being acquired by Duke Energy in 2012. The company had over 21,000 megawatts of generation capacity.

providence-and-worcester-railroad.name: Providence and Worcester Railroad
providence-and-worcester-railroad.description: The Providence and Worcester Railroad is a Class II railroad operating 612 miles of track in Rhode Island, Massachusetts, Connecticut, and New York. Founded in 1844, it began operations in 1847 and expanded its network over time. The railroad's mainline was double-tracked after an 1853 collision.

plasson-industries-ltd.name: Plasson Industries Ltd.
plasson-industries-ltd.description: Plasson Industries Ltd. is an Israeli global manufacturer of plastic fittings for pipes used in water, gas, industrial fluid, wastewater systems, and mines. Its division Plasson Poultry manufactures systems for poultry farming. The company is listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and included in the TA-100 Index.

pacific-edge-limited.name: Pacific Edge Limited
pacific-edge-limited.description: Pacific Edge Limited is a New Zealand-based company focusing on cancer diagnostics, particularly bladder cancer diagnostic tools using genetic biomarkers. It operates offices in Dunedin, New Zealand, and Hershey, USA, and is listed on the Australian ASX and New Zealand NZX stock exchanges.

prontoforms.name: ProntoForms
prontoforms.description: TrueContext, formerly ProntoForms Corporation, is a Canadian app development company providing a low-code platform for building software and mobile apps. Its application digitizes paperwork for mobile data collection and transmission. The company went public in 2005 and trades on the TSX Venture Exchange.

pushpay.name: Pushpay
pushpay.description: Pushpay Holdings Limited is a mobile giving, donor management, and church management software company serving faith-based and nonprofit organizations in the United States. It was publicly listed on the New Zealand and Australian stock exchanges before being taken private in 2023.

paz-retail-and-energy.name: Paz Retail And Energy
paz-retail-and-energy.description: Paz Oil Company Ltd. is Israel's largest oil and gas company. It distributes gasoline and petroleum products through gas stations and supplies LPG and natural gas for home use via its subsidiary PazGaz. The company also operates convenience stores and owns supermarket chains Freshmarket and Super Yuda.

prabhu-bank-limited.name: Prabhu Bank Limited
prabhu-bank-limited.description: Prabhu Bank Limited is a commercial bank in Nepal headquartered in Kathmandu. It is an 'A' class bank licensed by Nepal Rastra Bank and provides full commercial banking services with branches across the nation.

pinnacle-west-capital-corporation.name: Pinnacle West Capital Corporation
pinnacle-west-capital-corporation.description: Pinnacle West Capital Corporation is an American utility holding company that owns Arizona Public Service (APS). APS is the largest utility company in Arizona and is regulated by the Arizona Corporation Commission.

pennon-group.name: Pennon Group
pennon-group.description: Pennon Group plc is a British water utility company based in Exeter, England. Its main subsidiary is South West Water, which contributes much of the company's profits.

post-holdings.name: Post Holdings
post-holdings.description: Post Holdings, Inc. is an American consumer packaged goods holding company headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. It operates businesses in center-of-the-store, refrigerated, foodservice, and food ingredient categories.

puma-biotechnology.name: Puma Biotechnology
puma-biotechnology.description: Puma Biotechnology is a publicly traded biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Los Angeles, California, United States. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry focusing on biotechnology.

perrigo-company-plc.name: Perrigo Company Plc
perrigo-company-plc.description: Perrigo Company plc is an American manufacturer of private label over-the-counter pharmaceuticals legally headquartered in Ireland for tax purposes. While 70% of its net sales come from the U.S. healthcare system, its corporate headquarters are in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Perrigo completed a major US corporate tax inversion in 2013.

precigen-inc.name: Precigen, Inc
precigen-inc.description: Precigen, Inc. is an American biotechnology company. Its president and CEO is Helen Sabzevari.

pacific-premier-bancorp.name: Pacific Premier Bancorp
pacific-premier-bancorp.description: Pacific Premier Bancorp, Inc. was an American bank holding company headquartered in Irvine, California. Its main business was Pacific Premier Bank, which offered financial services to individuals, businesses, and professionals, operating branches in California, Arizona, Nevada, and Washington.

pershing-square-holdings.name: Pershing Square Holdings
pershing-square-holdings.description: Pershing Square Holdings is a Guernsey-based investment trust and financial services company. It is part of the FTSE 100 Index on the London Stock Exchange and is managed by Bill Ackman of Pershing Square Capital Management. The fund tracks the performance of the American fund managed by Pershing Square Capital.

pdg-s-a.name: PDG S.A.
pdg-s-a.description: PDG is a Brazilian real estate development company based in Rio de Janeiro. It is the second largest real estate and homebuilder in Brazil, focusing on the residential market.

pow-entertainment.name: POW! Entertainment
pow-entertainment.description: POW! Entertainment Inc. is an American media production company founded in 2001 by Gill Champion, Arthur Lieberman, and Stan Lee. It consists of a holding corporation and its wholly owned subsidiary. The company is currently owned by Camsing International Holding.

parque-arauco-s-a.name: Parque Arauco S.A.
parque-arauco-s-a.description: Parque Arauco is a Chilean company managing shopping malls in Chile, Peru, and Colombia. It is headquartered in Santiago and is the third largest shopping mall company in Chile. The company operates 24 shopping malls with a total gross leasable area of 672,700 square meters.

patterson-uti-energy-inc.name: Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc
patterson-uti-energy-inc.description: Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc. provides land drilling, pressure pumping, directional drilling, rental equipment, and technology services. It operates in the United States and western Canada, serving clients in the petroleum industry.

pep-boys.name: Pep Boys
pep-boys.description: Pep Boys is an American automotive aftermarket service chain founded in Philadelphia in 1921. Headquartered in Bala Cynwyd, Pennsylvania, it provides tires, automotive maintenance, repair, and fleet services across the United States, including mobile maintenance through its service trailers.

phoenix-beverages.name: Phoenix Beverages
phoenix-beverages.description: Phoenix Beverages is the largest brewery in Mauritius, producing Phoenix Beer and other beverages. It operates three plants in Mauritius and one in Reunion Island, has connections with Guinness Brewery, and is listed on the Stock Exchange of Mauritius.

piper-sandler-companies.name: Piper Sandler Companies
piper-sandler-companies.description: Piper Sandler Companies is an American multinational investment bank and financial services firm. It offers services including mergers and acquisitions, financial restructuring, public offerings, and investment management, targeting corporations, institutional investors, and public entities.

power-assets-holdings-limited.name: Power Assets Holdings Limited
power-assets-holdings-limited.description: Power Assets Holdings Limited is a vertically integrated electric utility company based in Hong Kong. It is the majority shareholder in the Hongkong Electric Company and has reduced its holdings through share sales, most recently in June 2015.

principal-financial-group.name: Principal Financial Group
principal-financial-group.description: Principal Financial Group, Inc. is an American global financial investment management and insurance company headquartered in Des Moines, Iowa. It operates in the financial services sector.

platinum-studios.name: Platinum Studios
platinum-studios.description: Platinum Studios, Inc. is an American media company that develops, publishes, and licenses comic book properties for adaptation into film, television, and other media.

pegatron.name: PEGATRON
pegatron.description: Pegatron Corporation is a Taiwanese electronics manufacturer specializing in computing, communications, and consumer electronics for major brands. Its products include laptops, desktops, game consoles, motherboards, and broadband communication devices. The company is based in Taiwan.

pioneer-natural-resources.name: Pioneer Natural Resources
pioneer-natural-resources.description: Pioneer Natural Resources Company was engaged in hydrocarbon exploration and headquartered in Irving, Texas. It operated in the Cline Shale of the Permian Basin and was the largest acreage holder there. In May 2024, it was acquired by ExxonMobil.

polestar.name: Polestar
polestar.description: Polestar Automotive Holding UK PLC is a Swedish automotive manufacturer specializing in electric cars. Headquartered in Torslanda, Sweden, it is principally owned by PSD Investment, Geely Holding, and Volvo Cars. Polestar uses an asset-light approach, producing vehicles in facilities controlled by Volvo or Geely across several countries.

ponsse-corporation.name: Ponsse Corporation
ponsse-corporation.description: Ponsse Plc is a Finnish company that manufactures and markets forestry vehicles and machinery such as forwarders and harvesters. Founded in 1970, all its machines are produced in Vieremä, Finland, and are used in about 40 countries. The company employs over 2,000 people across 12 countries.

proofpoint-inc.name: Proofpoint, Inc.
proofpoint-inc.description: Proofpoint, Inc. is an American enterprise cybersecurity company based in Sunnyvale, California. It provides software as a service and products focused on email security, identity threat defense, data loss prevention, electronic discovery, and email archiving.

pitney-bowes.name: Pitney Bowes
pitney-bowes.description: Pitney Bowes Inc. is an American technology company known for postage meters and mailing equipment. Founded in 1920 by Arthur Pitney and Walter Bowes, it developed the first commercially available postage meter. The company offers various mailing technologies and services.

peab.name: Peab
peab.description: Peab AB is a construction and civil engineering company headquartered in Förslöv, Scania, Sweden. It is the third largest construction company in Sweden and the Nordic region and is listed on NASDAQ OMX Stockholm. Peab operates in Sweden, Norway, and Finland.

ppg-industries.name: PPG Industries
ppg-industries.description: PPG Industries, Inc. is an American supplier of paints, coatings, and specialty materials headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It operates globally in over 70 countries and is the second largest coatings company by revenue. Its headquarters is located in PPG Place, known for its glass facade designed by Philip Johnson.

pagerduty.name: PagerDuty
pagerduty.description: PagerDuty, Inc. is an American cloud computing company that provides a SaaS incident management platform for IT operations departments. The company specializes in technology solutions for managing IT incidents.

portuguese-investment-bank.name: Portuguese Investment Bank
portuguese-investment-bank.description: Banco BPI, formerly Banco Português de Investimento, is a Portuguese private investment bank headquartered in Porto. Founded in 1981, it serves companies, institutional, and private clients. It is the third largest private Portuguese financial group and is owned by CaixaBank.

patterson-companies.name: Patterson Companies
patterson-companies.description: Patterson Companies, Inc. is an American company based in Mendota Heights, Minnesota. Established in 1877 as a dental company, it expanded into the animal health industry in 2001 and further grew with a 2015 acquisition.

planar-systems.name: Planar Systems
planar-systems.description: Planar Systems, Inc. is an American digital display manufacturer based in Hillsboro, Oregon. Founded in 1983 as a spin-off from Tektronix, it was the first U.S. manufacturer of electroluminescent digital displays. Since 2015, it has been an independent subsidiary of Leyard Optoelectronic Co.

peloton.name: Peloton
peloton.description: Peloton Interactive, Inc. is an American exercise equipment and media company based in New York City. It produces stationary bicycles, treadmills, and indoor rowers with internet-connected touch screens that stream live and on-demand fitness classes through a subscription service.

poly-developments.name: Poly Developments
poly-developments.description: Poly Real Estate Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese real estate developer and a subsidiary of the state-owned China Poly Group. It focuses on the design, development, construction, and sale of residential and commercial properties, along with property management services in China.

pepco-holdings-inc.name: Pepco Holdings, Inc.
pepco-holdings-inc.description: Pepco Holdings, Inc. was a holding company for electric utilities in the Northeastern United States. It merged with Exelon in 2016.

pharmaniaga.name: Pharmaniaga
pharmaniaga.description: Pharmaniaga Berhad is Malaysia’s largest listed integrated healthcare company. It offers research and development, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution of pharmaceuticals and medical supplies.

pos-malaysia.name: Pos Malaysia
pos-malaysia.hq: Kuala Lumpur General Post Office, Malaysia
pos-malaysia.description: Pos Malaysia Berhad is the Malaysian national postal and courier service provider headquartered in Kuala Lumpur. Originally a government department from the early 1800s, it was corporatized in 1992 and now operates in postal, courier, aviation, logistics, and IT sectors.

planet-13.name: Planet 13
planet-13.description: Planet 13 Holdings, Inc. is a cannabis company based in Nevada, United States. It opened the world's largest cannabis dispensary in Las Vegas on November 1, 2018, covering 112,000 square feet.

panda-electronics.name: Panda Electronics
panda-electronics.description: Panda Electronics is a Chinese manufacturer and brand producing electronic products such as mobile phones, datacards, TV sets, set top boxes, administrative software, electronic instruments, and satellite and mobile communication devices.

ptt-exploration-and-production-public-co.name: PTT Exploration and Production Public Company Limited
ptt-exploration-and-production-public-co.legal_name: PTT Exploration and Production Public Company Limited
ptt-exploration-and-production-public-co.description: PTT Exploration and Production Public Company Limited, also known as PTTEP, is a national petroleum exploration and production company based in Thailand. It is a subsidiary of the state-owned PTT Public Company Limited and was founded on 20 June 1985.

listings.name: PTT Exploration and Production Public Company Limited

publix.name: Publix
publix.description: Publix Super Markets, Inc. is an employee-owned American supermarket chain headquartered in Lakeland, Florida. Founded in 1930, it operates throughout the Southeastern United States with locations in multiple states including Florida, Georgia, and Kentucky. It is wholly owned by present and past employees and members of the Jenkins family.

pathward.name: Pathward
pathward.description: Pathward Financial, Inc. is a U.S.-based banking and financial services company. It adopted its current name in 2022 after its parent, Meta Financial Group, sold the "Meta" trademark to Meta Platforms.

pc-connection.name: PC Connection
pc-connection.description: PC Connection, Inc., doing business as Connection, is headquartered in Merrimack, New Hampshire. The company employs over 2,600 people and sells more than 460,000 products. It operates in the technology sector.

pdf-solutions.name: PDF Solutions
pdf-solutions.description: PDF Solutions, Inc. is an American multinational software and engineering services company based in Santa Clara, California. It is publicly traded on the Nasdaq stock exchange under the ticker PDFS.

pfsweb.name: PFSweb
pfsweb.description: PFSweb, Inc. is an eCommerce fulfillment and logistics third-party service provider for business-to-business and direct-to-consumer companies. Its headquarters moved from Allen, Texas to Irving, Texas in 2022. The company operates distribution centers in the US, UK, Belgium, and Canada.

ps-business-parks.name: PS Business Parks
ps-business-parks.description: PS Business Parks, Inc. was a publicly traded real estate investment trust that owned and operated commercial properties, mainly multi-tenant industrial, flex, and office spaces. Its portfolio included 97 properties across several US states and 800 residential units in Virginia. In 2022, its holdings were transferred to Link Logistics Real Estate, affiliated with Blackstone Real Estate.

ptc-therapeutics.name: PTC Therapeutics
ptc-therapeutics.description: PTC Therapeutics, Inc. is a U.S.-based pharmaceutical company that develops orally administered small molecule drugs and gene therapies targeting orphan diseases through post-transcriptional control mechanisms. The company focuses on altering gene expression to treat these conditions.

pv-crystalox-solar.name: PV Crystalox Solar
pv-crystalox-solar.description: PV Crystalox Solar plc is a United Kingdom-based supplier of multicrystalline silicon wafers used in solar electricity generation systems. It operates in Germany, the UK, and Japan, with its headquarters in the UK, and is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

pacsun.name: PacSun
pacsun.description: Pacific Sunwear of California, LLC, known as PacSun, is an American retail clothing brand headquartered in Anaheim, California. It sells lifestyle apparel and accessories for teens and young adults and operates stores across the United States and Puerto Rico. The company went bankrupt in 2016 and is now owned by Golden Gate Capital.

pactera.name: Pactera
pactera.description: Pactera Technology International Ltd. is an IT consulting and outsourcing company headquartered in Beijing, China, with regional offices in North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. It serves sectors including technology, telecom, finance, insurance, energy, travel, manufacturing, retail, and logistics.

pagbank.name: PagBank
pagbank.description: PagBank is a financial services and digital payments company based in São Paulo, Brazil, incorporated in the Cayman Islands. Founded in 2006, it offers payment processing software for e-commerce, mobile apps, and point of sale terminals.

pakistan-tobacco-company.name: Pakistan Tobacco Company
pakistan-tobacco-company.description: Pakistan Tobacco Company Limited is a tobacco manufacturer based in Islamabad, Pakistan. It is a subsidiary of British American Tobacco and operates two factories in Akora Khattak and Jhelum, being the largest cigarette manufacturer in Pakistan.

panacea-biotec.name: Panacea Biotec
panacea-biotec.description: Panacea Biotec is an Indian pharmaceutical company with offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, and Lalru. It engages in research, development, manufacturing, and marketing of pharmaceutical formulations, vaccines, biosimilars, and natural products.

panera-bread.name: Panera Bread
panera-bread.description: Panera Bread Company is an American multinational bakery-cafe fast casual restaurant chain headquartered in Fenton, Missouri. It operates over 2,000 locations in the United States and Canada and is known as Saint Louis Bread Company in the Greater St. Louis area.

panin-sekuritas.name: Panin Sekuritas
panin-sekuritas.description: PT. Panin Sekuritas Tbk is a financial services company specializing in stock brokerage based in Jakarta, Indonesia. It is part of Panin Group and manages securities and mutual funds. The company was awarded Best Securities Company in 2006 and 2007 by Investor magazine.

panmure-gordon-co.name: Panmure Gordon & Co.
panmure-gordon-co.description: Panmure Gordon was a UK-based investment bank offering services including investment banking, trading, research, and sales across the UK, Europe, and the US. On July 1, 2024, it merged with Liberum Capital to form Panmure Liberum.

panorama9.name: Panorama9
panorama9.description: Panorama9 is a cloud-based service focused on network management. It operates within the information technology management industry in the United States.

pangang-group-vanadium-titanium-resource.name: Pangang Group Vanadium Titanium & Resources
pangang-group-vanadium-titanium-resource.description: Pangang Group Vanadium Titanium & Resources Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company involved in manufacturing and selling iron, steel, and vanadium products. It is headquartered in Panzhihua, Sichuan, and is parented by Panzhihua Iron and Steel.

paylocity-corporation.name: Paylocity Corporation
paylocity-corporation.description: Paylocity Holding Corporation is an American company providing cloud-based payroll, spend management, and human capital management software. It operates in the United States.

pegasystems.name: Pegasystems
pegasystems.description: Pegasystems Inc. is a global AI software company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, USA. It offers a low-code platform for workflow automation, business process management, and AI-powered decision-making. The company has been publicly traded since 1996.

pelwatte-sugar-industries-plc.name: Pelwatte Sugar Industries PLC
pelwatte-sugar-industries-plc.description: Pelwatte Sugar Industries PLC is a Sri Lankan sugar manufacturing company listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange. Its main factory is located in Buttala, Uva Province. The company was incorporated in 1981 and became a public limited company in 1982.

pengrowth-energy.name: Pengrowth Energy
pengrowth-energy.description: Pengrowth Energy Corporation was a Canadian oil and natural gas company based in Calgary, Alberta. Established in 1988, it was one of the largest Canadian royalty trusts with assets evenly split between oil and natural gas. The company was founded by entrepreneur James S Kinnear.

pennsylvania-real-estate-investment-trus.name: Pennsylvania Real Estate Investment Trust
pennsylvania-real-estate-investment-trus.description: PREIT Realty is a privately held company that owns and develops shopping centers, primarily in the Mid-Atlantic states of the United States. It operates in the real estate investment trust industry.

pentair.name: Pentair
pentair.description: Pentair plc is an American water treatment company incorporated in Ireland with tax residency in the UK. Founded in the US, it has its main US office in Golden Valley, Minnesota. The company reorganized in 2014, shifting its corporate domicile from Switzerland to Ireland.

people-s-united-financial.name: People's United Financial
people-s-united-financial.description: People's United Financial, Inc. was an American bank holding company owning People's United Bank. It operated 403 branches across several northeastern US states and was the second-largest full-service bank in New England and 46th-largest in the US.

perficient.name: Perficient
perficient.industry: Business and other management consultancy activities
perficient.description: Perficient, Inc. is a global digital consultancy based in St. Louis, Missouri, USA. It offers services including enterprise mobile applications, creative services, marketing, digital strategy, Internet of Things, IT, management consulting, custom development, and platform implementations.

perpetual-limited.name: Perpetual Limited
perpetual-limited.description: Perpetual is an Australian investment fund and trustee group listed in the S&P/ASX 200. It provides investment products, financial advice, philanthropic, and corporate services to individuals, families, financial advisers, and organizations.

perry-ellis-international.name: Perry Ellis International
perry-ellis-international.description: Perry Ellis International is an American company headquartered in Doral, Florida, specializing in clothing, fashion, cosmetics, and beauty. It manages a portfolio of brands distributed worldwide, focusing mainly on sportswear and casual clothing for niche markets.

petmed-express.name: PetMed Express
petmed-express.description: PetMed Express, Inc., also known as PetMeds, is an online pet pharmacy based in the United States. It sells prescription and non-prescription pet medication and is publicly traded. The company operates in the veterinary medicine industry.

petro-rabigh.name: Petro Rabigh
petro-rabigh.description: Rabigh Refining & Petrochemical Company is a Saudi Arabian petrochemical company founded in 2005 as a joint venture between Saudi Aramco and Sumitomo Chemical. It produces and markets refined hydrocarbons and petrochemicals and is the only producer of propylene oxide in the Middle East.

petronet-lng.name: Petronet LNG
petronet-lng.description: Petronet LNG Limited is an Indian oil and gas company formed by the Government of India to import liquefied natural gas and establish LNG terminals. It has set up LNG receiving and regasification terminals in Dahej, Gujarat, and Kochi, Kerala, and is promoted by major Indian energy companies.

pets-at-home.name: Pets at Home
pets-at-home.description: Pets at Home Group PLC is a British retailer selling pets, pet food, toys, bedding, and medication. It operates in the retail industry and is based in the United Kingdom.

pharmaceutical-product-development.name: Pharmaceutical Product Development
pharmaceutical-product-development.description: Pharmaceutical Product Development (PPD) is a global contract research organization providing integrated drug development, laboratory, and lifecycle management services. It became a wholly owned subsidiary of Thermo Fisher Scientific in December 2021. The company is based in the United States.

philtrust-bank.name: Philtrust Bank
philtrust-bank.description: The Philippine Trust Company, known as Philtrust Bank, is one of the oldest private universal banks in the Philippines. Founded in 1916, it is the third bank established in the country and was owned by Chinese-Filipino businessman Emilio Yap.

phoenix-group.name: Phoenix Group
phoenix-group.description: Standard Life plc, formerly Phoenix Group Holdings plc, is a provider of insurance services based in London, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

phreesia-inc.name: Phreesia Inc.
phreesia-inc.description: Phreesia, Inc. is a software as a service company based in the United States that provides healthcare organizations with applications to automate and manage patient intake. It focuses on improving healthcare administration through technology.

pier-1-imports.name: Pier 1 Imports
pier-1-imports.description: Pier 1 Imports, Inc. was a United States-based retail chain and online retailer specializing in imported home furnishings and decor. It operated over 1,000 stores in the US and Canada before filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2020 and subsequently closing all stores.

pinnacle-financial-partners.name: Pinnacle Financial Partners
pinnacle-financial-partners.description: Pinnacle Financial Partners, Inc. is an American bank headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee. It operates in Tennessee and several other states including Kentucky, Maryland, and Florida.

pixela-corporation.name: Pixela Corporation
pixela-corporation.description: Pixela Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of PC peripheral hardware and multimedia software headquartered in Osaka. It is known for its ImageMixer software series and manufacturing 1seg Tuners in Japan.

plains-exploration-production.name: Plains Exploration & Production
plains-exploration-production.description: Plains Exploration & Production was a petroleum and natural gas exploration company based in Houston, Texas. It was acquired by Freeport-McMoRan in May 2013.

planet-fitness.name: Planet Fitness
planet-fitness.description: Planet Fitness, Inc. is an American franchisor and operator of fitness centers based in Hampton, New Hampshire. It operates thousands of clubs internationally and targets casual and first-time gym users.

plug-power.name: Plug Power
plug-power.description: Plug Power Inc. is an American company that develops hydrogen fuel cell and electrolyzer systems to replace conventional batteries in electric equipment and vehicles. It is headquartered in Slingerlands, New York, with additional facilities in Spokane, Washington, and Rochester, New York.

pluri-inc.name: Pluri Inc.
pluri-inc.description: Pluri Inc., formerly Pluristem Therapeutics, is an Israeli biotechnology company focused on developing human placental adherent stromal cells for disease treatment. The company extracts adult stem cells exclusively from postnatal placentas.

poplar.name: Poplar
poplar.description: Poplar is a convenience store franchise chain operating in Japan.

popular-inc.name: Popular, Inc.
popular-inc.description: Popular, Inc., also known as Banco Popular de Puerto Rico, is a full-service financial services conglomerate headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico. Founded in 1893, it is the largest banking institution in Puerto Rico and has expanded into the Caribbean and Latin America.

port-of-bar.name: Port of Bar
port-of-bar.description: The Port of Bar is Montenegro's main sea port located in the city of Bar. It serves as a key maritime gateway for the country.

portland-general-electric.name: Portland General Electric
portland-general-electric.description: Portland General Electric is a publicly traded energy company based in Portland, Oregon. It generates, transmits, and distributes electricity, serving a large portion of Oregon's commercial and industrial sectors.

porto-seguro-s-a.name: Porto Seguro S.A.
porto-seguro-s-a.description: Porto Seguro is the third largest insurance company in Brazil, founded in 1945. It operates through subsidiaries in Brazil and Uruguay and is headquartered in São Paulo.

post-properties.name: Post Properties
post-properties.description: Post Properties, Inc. was a publicly traded real estate investment trust headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It invested in apartments and was acquired by Mid-America Apartment Communities in 2016.

potlatch-corp.name: Potlatch Corp.
potlatch-corp.description: PotlatchDeltic Corporation is an American diversified forest products company based in Spokane, Washington. It operates in the forest products industry.

powell-industries.name: Powell Industries
powell-industries.description: Powell Industries, Inc. is a Houston, Texas-based manufacturer of integrated solutions and electrical equipment. It focuses on monitoring and controlling electrical power distribution in commercial and industrial markets.

preferred-bank.name: Preferred Bank
preferred-bank.description: Preferred Bank is a California state-chartered bank founded in 1991 to serve the Chinese American community in Southern California. It expanded through acquisition in 2015 after regulatory concerns in 2010.

premier-foods.name: Premier Foods
premier-foods.description: Premier Foods plc is a British food manufacturer headquartered in St Albans, Hertfordshire. It owns many well-known brands and produces cakes under the Cadbury's name under license.

premier-oil.name: Premier Oil
premier-oil.description: Premier Oil plc was an independent UK oil company with gas and oil interests in the United Kingdom, Asia, Africa, and Mexico. It focused on the upstream sector of the petroleum industry, involving the exploitation of oil and gas. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition and merger into Harbour Energy in March 2021.

prestige-brands.name: Prestige Brands
prestige-brands.description: Prestige Consumer Healthcare Inc. is an American company marketing and distributing over-the-counter healthcare and household cleaning products. It was formed in 1996 by the merger of three companies and is headquartered in Tarrytown, New York, with a manufacturing facility in Lynchburg, Virginia.

phoenix-television.name: Phoenix Television
phoenix-television.description: Phoenix Television is a majority state-owned television network operating Mandarin and Cantonese-language channels serving mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and other Chinese-speaking regions. It is headquartered in Shenzhen and Hong Kong and registered in the Cayman Islands.

priceline-com.name: priceline.com
priceline-com.description: Priceline.com is an online travel agency headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut, United States. Founded in 1997, it offers discount rates for travel-related purchases and is wholly owned by Booking Holdings. The company operates globally with partnerships with over 400 airlines and 300,000 hotels.

primerica.name: Primerica
primerica.description: Primerica, Inc. is a multi-level marketing company providing insurance, investment, and financial services to middle-income families in the United States and Canada. It operates within the financial services industry.

procera-networks.name: Procera Networks
procera-networks.description: Procera Networks is a networking equipment company based in Fremont, California, United States. It designs and sells Network Intelligence solutions based on deep packet inspection technology to telecom operators, governments, enterprises, and network equipment vendors.

prosperity-bancshares.name: Prosperity Bancshares
prosperity-bancshares.description: Prosperity Bancshares, Inc. is a bank holding company headquartered in Houston, Texas, with operations in Texas and central Oklahoma. It operates 285 branches across various regions including Houston, Dallas–Fort Worth, and Oklahoma.

provida.name: Provida
provida.description: AFP Provida, or Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Provida, is the leading pension fund manager of the Chilean Pension Fund. It operates in Chile and manages pension funds for the country.

provident-bank-of-new-jersey.name: Provident Bank of New Jersey
provident-bank-of-new-jersey.description: Provident Financial Services, Inc. is the holding company for Provident Bank, established in 1839. The bank provides financial services to businesses and individuals in New Jersey, New York, and eastern Pennsylvania, offering deposit, loan, investment, trust, fiduciary, and wealth management products.

pultegroup.name: PulteGroup
pultegroup.description: PulteGroup, Inc. is an American residential home-construction company based in Atlanta, Georgia. It is the third-largest home-construction company in the United States by number of homes closed and has built over 775,000 homes as of 2023.

progress-software.name: Progress Software
progress-software.description: Progress Software Corporation is an American public company that produces software for creating and deploying business applications. It was founded in Burlington, Massachusetts, and has offices in 16 countries as of 2024.

picc-property-and-casualty-co-ltd.name: PICC Property and Casualty Co. Ltd.
picc-property-and-casualty-co-ltd.legal_name: PICC Property and Casualty Co. Ltd.
picc-property-and-casualty-co-ltd.description: PICC Property and Casualty Company Limited is the largest non-life insurance company in mainland China. It was incorporated in 2003 and is one of the three main subsidiaries of the People's Insurance Company of China. The company operates in the insurance sector.

listings.name: PICC Property and Casualty Co. Ltd.

parexel.name: PAREXEL
parexel.description: Parexel is an American contract research organization that conducts clinical trials for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients. Its services aim to expedite drug development and clinical trial progress.

pakistan-international-container-termina.name: Pakistan International Container Terminal
pakistan-international-container-termina.description: Pakistan International Container Terminal (PICT) was a Pakistani container terminal operator managing berths 6 to 9 at the Port of Karachi under a 21-year BOT concession from 2002 to 2023. It operated as a subsidiary of ICTSI Mauritius Limited, part of the Philippines-based ICTSI group, from 2012 to 2023.

potash-corporation-of-saskatchewan.name: Potash Corporation of Saskatchewan
potash-corporation-of-saskatchewan.description: The Potash Corporation of Saskatchewan, also known as PotashCorp, was a company based in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. It merged with Calgary-based Agrium to form Nutrien, with the transaction closing on January 1, 2018.

paychex.name: Paychex
paychex.description: Paychex, Inc. is an American company providing human resources, payroll, and employee benefits outsourcing services for small- to medium-sized businesses. Founded in 1971, it is headquartered in Rochester, New York, and serves approximately 800,000 payroll clients in the U.S. and Europe. It is ranked 681st on the Fortune 500 list of largest corporations by revenue.

playtika.name: Playtika
playtika.description: Playtika Holding Corp. is an Israeli digital entertainment company specializing in developing and publishing mobile games. In 2021, it had over 35 million monthly active users.

postal-savings-bank-of-china.name: Postal Savings Bank of China
postal-savings-bank-of-china.description: Postal Savings Bank of China Co., Ltd. (PSBC) is a Chinese retail bank headquartered in Beijing. It provides basic financial services to small and medium enterprises, rural, and low-income customers, operating nearly 40,000 branches across China.

pemex.name: Pemex
pemex.description: Pemex is the Mexican state-owned petroleum corporation formed in 1938 by nationalizing private oil companies. It is managed by the Mexican government and is a symbol of Mexican nationalism. Pemex is one of Latin America's largest enterprises by revenue.

polskie-gornictwo-naftowe-i-gazownictwo.name: Polskie Górnictwo Naftowe i Gazownictwo
polskie-gornictwo-naftowe-i-gazownictwo.description: Polskie Górnictwo Naftowe i Gazownictwo S.A. (PGNiG) is a Polish state-controlled oil and gas company headquartered in Warsaw. It has branches and representative offices in Russia, Pakistan, Belarus, and Ukraine, and holds equity interests in about 30 subsidiaries providing specialist geophysical, drilling, and well services.

puig.name: Puig
puig.description: Puig Brands, S.A. is a Spanish premium beauty company founded in 1914 by Antonio Puig Castelló in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. The company remains under the management of the Puig family and operates in the fashion and beauty sector.

pall-corporation.name: Pall Corporation
pall-corporation.description: Pall Corporation is a global supplier of filtration, separations, and purification products headquartered in Port Washington, New York. It operates in Life Sciences and Industrial sectors and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Danaher Corporation since 2015.

plantronics.name: Plantronics
plantronics.description: Plantronics, Inc., formerly known as Poly, is an American multinational electronics company headquartered in Santa Cruz, California. It produces audio communications equipment for business and consumer use, supporting unified communications, mobile use, gaming, and music, with most products manufactured in China and Mexico.

pharmstandard.name: Pharmstandard
pharmstandard.description: JSC Pharmstandard is a Russian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Dolgoprudny, Moscow Oblast. It operates in the healthcare and pharmaceutical industry.

plains-all-american-pipeline.name: Plains All American Pipeline
plains-all-american-pipeline.description: Plains All American Pipeline is a master limited partnership headquartered in Houston, Texas. It operates pipeline transport, marketing, and storage of liquefied petroleum gas and petroleum in the US and Canada. The company owns extensive pipeline and storage assets across key producing basins and market hubs.

politec.name: Politec
politec.description: Politec is an IT outsourcing service provider based in Brasília, Brazil. The company employs over 6,000 people and was acquired in 2011 by the Spanish company Indra Sistemas. Politec operates in the information technology sector.

productos-ramo.name: Productos Ramo
productos-ramo.description: Productos Ramo SA is a Colombian snack food company known for competing with multinational brands. Its popular products include Gala pastries, Chocoramo chocolate-coated cake, and snacks like Tostacos and Maizitos.

paz-del-rio-steel-mills.name: Paz del Río Steel Mills
paz-del-rio-steel-mills.description: Acerías Paz del Río is a Colombian steel and iron company controlled by Grupo Trinity S.A. It operates in the iron and steel industry within Colombia.

paradise-aircraft.name: Paradise Aircraft
paradise-aircraft.description: Paradise Industria Aeronautica Ltda is a Brazilian aircraft manufacturer founded in 2001 and based in Feira de Santana, Bahia State. The company specializes in designing and manufacturing light aircraft, particularly ready-to-fly models for the American light-sport aircraft category.

penumbra.name: Penumbra
penumbra.description: Penumbra, Inc. is an American medical device company headquartered in Alameda, California. Founded in 2004 by Arani Bose and Adam Elsesser, it manufactures devices for interventional therapies to treat vascular conditions such as stroke and aneurysm.

polski-holding-nieruchomosci.name: Polski Holding Nieruchomości
polski-holding-nieruchomosci.description: Polski Holding Nieruchomości is a Polish real estate company headquartered in Warsaw. It has a holding structure controlling dozens of subsidiaries and has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since February 2013.

posco-future-m.name: POSCO Future M
posco-future-m.description: POSCO Future M Co., Ltd. is a South Korean battery material and chemical company. It produces cathode and anode materials for lithium-ion batteries, refractories, and basic industrial materials.

postmedia-network.name: Postmedia Network
postmedia-network.description: Postmedia Network Canada Corp. is a Canadian media conglomerate majority-owned by American investors. It operates English-language newspaper publishing, news gathering, and internet operations. The company owns over 130 print and digital news titles including the National Post and Financial Post.

petroleum-geo-services.name: Petroleum Geo-Services
petroleum-geo-services.description: Petroleum Geo-Services (PGS) was a Norwegian oilfield service company providing geophysical services worldwide. Its seismic services helped oil companies identify offshore oil and gas reserves, offering products from survey planning to advanced imaging and reservoir analysis.

parques-reunidos.name: Parques Reunidos
parques-reunidos.description: Parques Reunidos is an international entertainment operator based in Madrid, Spain. It operates over 60 parks in nine countries, including theme parks, zoos, water parks, family entertainment centers, and cable cars. The group has facilities across Europe and attracts millions of annual visitors.

pricol.name: Pricol
pricol.description: Pricol Limited is an automotive components manufacturer based in Coimbatore, India. Founded in 1975, it produces parts for motorcycles, cars, trucks, and off-road vehicles, as well as sintered components and fleet management products.

punch-pubs.name: Punch Pubs
punch-pubs.description: Punch Pubs & Co is a pub and bar operator based in Burton upon Trent, England, United Kingdom. It operates around 1,300 leased pubs. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its sale in 2016 to a private equity fund and Heineken International.

parsian-bank.name: Parsian Bank
parsian-bank.description: Parsian Bank is a major private bank headquartered in Tehran, Iran. It offers traditional banking services along with diversified services such as insurance and car rentals. The bank is reportedly controlled by the Supreme Leader’s business empire.

pavlovo-bus-factory.name: Pavlovo Bus Factory
pavlovo-bus-factory.description: Pavlovo Bus Factory is a Russian manufacturer of buses located in Pavlovo, Nizhny Novgorod Oblast. Since 2005, bus production has been carried out by PAZ, a 100% subsidiary of PAO Pavlovsky Avtobus. PAZ is a subsidiary of Russian Buses, which is a division of GAZ.

petrofac.name: Petrofac
petrofac.description: Petrofac Limited is a British international energy services company that designs, builds, manages, and maintains oil, gas, refining, petrochemicals, and renewable energy infrastructure. It is registered in Jersey with its main office in London and filed for bankruptcy protection in October 2025.

patagonia-bank.name: Patagonia Bank
patagonia-bank.description: Banco Patagonia is an Argentine commercial bank headquartered in Buenos Aires with 200 service points across Argentina. It serves individual clients and small to medium-sized businesses, with over 775,000 clients.

pizza-delight.name: Pizza Delight
pizza-delight.description: Pizza Delight is a Canadian pizza restaurant franchise founded in 1968 in Shediac, New Brunswick. It primarily serves pizza, pasta, and salad dishes and operates over 70 restaurants mainly in Ontario and the Atlantic provinces. Its head offices are located in Moncton.

petra-diamonds.name: Petra Diamonds
petra-diamonds.description: Petra Diamonds Ltd is a diamond mining group headquartered in Jersey. It owns the historically productive Cullinan Diamond Mine, known for producing the world's largest rough and polished diamonds. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

pbg-sa.name: PBG SA
pbg-sa.description: PBG SA is a Polish engineering company engaged in the design, execution, and repair of pipelines and equipment for transporting oil, natural gas, water, and wastewater. It also works on infrastructure for heating and fuel storage facilities.

peachtree-financial-solutions.name: Peachtree Financial Solutions
peachtree-financial-solutions.description: Peachtree Financial Solutions is a company based in Radnor, Pennsylvania, that provides cash to individuals with illiquid assets such as structured settlements, annuities, lottery winnings, and active lawsuits.

pet-inc.name: Pet, Inc.
pet-inc.description: Pet, Inc. was an American company known for being the first to commercially produce evaporated milk as a shelf-stable consumer product under the "PET Milk" brand. While popular before widespread refrigeration, evaporated milk sales peaked in the 1950s and now serve niche uses in baking and cooking.

photocure.name: Photocure
photocure.description: Photocure ASA is a Norwegian specialty pharmaceutical company that develops and sells pharmaceuticals and medical devices based on proprietary photodynamic technology. It focuses on bladder cancer diagnostics and cancer portfolio development.

pars-oil-company.name: Pars Oil Company
pars-oil-company.description: Pars Oil Company is an Iranian oil refining company headquartered in Tehran. It operates within the petroleum industry in Iran.

polymet-mining-corporation.name: Polymet Mining Corporation
polymet-mining-corporation.description: PolyMet Mining Corporation was an American mineral exploration and mine development company based in Minnesota, with corporate headquarters in Toronto, Canada. It controlled rights to the NorthMet Deposit in the Mesabi Range.

post-bank-of-iran.name: Post Bank of Iran
post-bank-of-iran.description: Post Bank of Iran is a banking institution based in Iran. It provides financial services within the country.

power-financial.name: Power Financial
power-financial.description: Power Financial Corporation is a Canadian multinational management and holding company founded in 1984. It has interests in financial services and asset management businesses across Canada, the US, and Europe.

premium-brands-holdings-corporation.name: Premium Brands Holdings Corporation
premium-brands-holdings-corporation.description: Premium Brands Holdings Corporation is a Canadian specialty food manufacturing and distribution company. It is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange. The company operates within the food manufacturing industry in Canada.

protective-life.name: Protective Life
protective-life.description: Protective Life Corporation is a financial services holding company based in Birmingham, Alabama.
