Its primary subsidiary, Protective Life Insurance Company, was established in 1907 and operates in all 50 states. The corporation owns several subsidiaries including West Coast Life Insurance Company and MONY Life Insurance Company.

power-corporation-of-canada.name: Power Corporation of Canada
power-corporation-of-canada.description: Power Corporation of Canada is a Canadian holding company founded in 1925. It focuses on financial services across North America, Europe, and Asia, with holdings in insurance, retirement services, wealth management, and alternative investments.

pharmamar.name: PharmaMar
pharmamar.description: PharmaMar is a Spanish pharmaceutical company headquartered in Colmenar Viejo, Madrid. Founded in 1986, it absorbed its parent company Zeltia in 2015 and is part of the Madrid Stock Exchange General Index and IBEX 35 since 2020.

pick-n-pay.name: Pick n Pay
pick-n-pay.description: Pick n Pay is a major South African retail chain headquartered in Cape Town. Founded in 1967, it operates around 2,300 stores. The company is listed on the JSE Limited stock exchange.

petro-air.name: Petro Air
petro-air.description: Petro Air is a charter airline based in Tripoli, Libya. The airline is banned from flying into EU airspace.

port-harcourt-refining-company.name: Port Harcourt Refining Company
port-harcourt-refining-company.description: Port Harcourt Refining Company is a Nigerian oil and gas firm specializing in refining crude oil into petroleum products. It is headquartered in the Port Harcourt metropolitan area of Rivers State. The company is a subsidiary of the Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation.

puntland-tv-and-radio.name: Puntland TV and Radio
puntland-tv-and-radio.description: Puntland TV and Radio is the public broadcasting network owned by the Puntland government in Somalia. Established in 2013, it broadcasts locally and globally via satellite and shortwave, with headquarters in Garowe and an office in London.

passion-air.name: Passion Air
passion-air.description: Pisces Aviation is a domestic airline of Ghana with its head office and main hub at Accra International Airport in Accra. It operates within Ghana.

puma.name: Puma
puma.description: Puma Automóveis Ltda. is a Brazilian sports car manufacturer established in 1963. It underwent several name changes, becoming Puma Veículos e Motores in 1964 and Puma Indústria de Veículos SA in 1974. The company is based in Brazil and specializes in automotive production.

pinguim-content.name: PinGuim Content
pinguim-content.description: PinGuim Content is a Brazilian animation studio founded in 1989 by Kiko Mistrorigo and Célia Catunda. It operates in the animation industry and is based in Brazil.

petroleo-ipiranga.name: Petroleo Ipiranga
petroleo-ipiranga.description: Ipiranga Produtos de Petróleo S.A, known as Ipiranga, is a Brazilian fuel company headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. It is the second-largest fuel distribution company in Brazil and the largest in the private sector.

prologica.name: Prológica
prologica.description: Prológica Indústria e Comércio de Microcomputadores was a Brazilian microcomputer company influential in the mid-1980s. It ranked third among national companies in the computer industry sector at its peak.

paris-filmes.name: Paris Filmes
paris-filmes.description: Paris Filmes is a Brazilian company involved in film distribution and production. It distributes movies in cinemas as well as on DVD and Blu-ray formats within Brazil.

placar-linhas-aereas.name: Placar Linhas Aéreas
placar-linhas-aereas.description: Placar Linhas Aéreas is a Brazilian non-scheduled passenger and cargo airline founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo. It began operations in 2023, focusing on transporting football teams for matches within Brazil and other South American countries.

protea-hotels.name: Protea Hotels
protea-hotels.description: Protea Hotels by Marriott is a South African hotel and leisure company headquartered in Cape Town. It was the largest hotel company on the African continent as of 2018, with 80 properties in ten countries.

public-investment-corporation.name: Public Investment Corporation
public-investment-corporation.description: The Public Investment Corporation (PIC) is a South African state-owned asset management firm headquartered in Pretoria, Gauteng. It is Africa's largest asset manager.

paramount-group.name: Paramount Group
paramount-group.description: Paramount Group is a South African aerospace and defense company established in 1994. It operates globally in internal security and peacekeeping, offering military aircraft, armored vehicles, maritime systems, equipment, and training to governments.

phoebus-apollo-aviation.name: Phoebus Apollo Aviation
phoebus-apollo-aviation.description: Phoebus Apollo Aviation is a South African airline based in Johannesburg, Germiston. It operates passenger, charter, and cargo flights and also runs a flight school. The company serves multiple aviation needs from its location.

public-establishment-of-television.name: Public Establishment of Television
public-establishment-of-television.description: Public Establishment of Television (EPTV) is a state-owned company managing television activities in Algeria, including production and broadcasting. It serves as the national television entity of the country.

patagonik-film-group.name: Patagonik Film Group
patagonik-film-group.description: Patagonik Film Group is an Argentine production company specializing in feature films and film production services. It is part of the Clarín Group and supports international film productions in Argentina.

plaza-vea.name: Plaza Vea
plaza-vea.description: Supermercados Peruanos S.A., trading as Super Food Holding, is a Peruvian company owning several supermarket chains. Founded in 1979, it adopted its current name in 2004 after acquisition by Interbank. It operates supermarkets and discount stores.

petroperu.name: Petroperú
petroperu.description: Petróleos del Perú, known as Petroperú, is a state-owned enterprise dedicated to transportation, refining, distribution, and commercialization of fuels and petroleum products. Owned by the State of Peru since 1969, it employs over 2,500 people.

peruvian-airlines.name: Peruvian Airlines
peruvian-airlines.description: Peruvian Air Line S.A. was a Peruvian airline based in Lima operating from 2009 to 2019. It primarily offered domestic flights from its main base at Jorge Chávez International Airport before ceasing operations due to liquidity issues.

petroleos-paraguayos.name: Petróleos Paraguayos
petroleos-paraguayos.description: Petróleos Paraguayos is the national oil company of Paraguay. It owns the Villa Elisa Refinery, the country's only refinery, along with a LNG plant, a biodiesel plant, and several storage facilities. The refinery is located in Villa Elisa and has a capacity of 7,500 barrels.

pichincha-bank.name: Pichincha Bank
pichincha-bank.description: Banco Pichincha is the largest private-sector bank in Ecuador by capitalization and number of depositors. It is the main bank of the Pichincha Group, which includes related companies such as Diners Club of Ecuador and Teleamazonas. The group is associated with Fidel Egas Grijalva and his family.

postobon.name: Postobón
postobon.description: Postobón is the largest beverage company in Colombia and one of the largest in South America. It offers a wide range of products including soft drinks, fruit juices, bottled water, tea, energy drinks, and coffee.

petroleum-air-services.name: Petroleum Air Services
petroleum-air-services.description: Petroleum Air Services (PAS) is an airline based in Cairo, Egypt, providing helicopter services to support the oil industry. It also operates commercial passenger services within Egypt and regional cities. Its main base is Cairo International Airport.

proflight-zambia.name: Proflight Zambia
proflight-zambia.description: Proflight Zambia is an airline based in Lusaka, Zambia, serving business and tourism sectors. It operates the largest fleet and route network in Zambia and is IOSA certified, providing both scheduled and charter flights.

paleteria-la-michoacana.name: Paletería La Michoacana
paleteria-la-michoacana.description: La Michoacana is a brand name used by several similar Mexican ice cream parlors. These are independent businesses that use the name but are not franchises, leading to variation in product quality, pricing, and assortment. The brand features pink branding and a Mexican woman in the logo.

productos-mendoza.name: Productos Mendoza
productos-mendoza.description: Productos Mendoza, S.A. is a Mexican manufacturer of air guns, stationery, and firearms based in Mexico City. Founded in 1911 by Rafael Mendoza Blanco, the company initially produced firearms for troops under General Francisco Villa during the Mexican Revolution.

punto-azul.name: Punto Azul
punto-azul.description: Punto Azul is a regional airline based in Malabo, Equatorial Guinea, with its main hub at Malabo International Airport. The airline operates scheduled flights mainly from Malabo, as well as private charters for the oil and gas industry and cargo services.
